verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own documentation includes an 'Install an application' / 'Remove an application' guide. Its marketing says thousands of applications are available, including popular ones like Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam and OBS Studio. However, nothing in the pack names a built-in graphical app store or describes single-click installation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a built-in app store (e.g. App Center), a documented one-click install flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the switcher install experience.
